llm_judge_report.task_name: Prepare two hamburgers and a salad

relevance.justification: All messages were highly relevant, focusing strictly on task allocation, ingredient processing, and failure resolution.

clarity.justification: Messages were unambiguous and well-structured, clearly stating robot locations, held items, available skills, and intended actions.

grounding.justification: Statements were perfectly grounded in the physical state, accurately reflecting robot capabilities (e.g., Robot_1 lacking CUT/COOK) and item requirements.

coordination_utility.justification: Communication facilitated capability discovery and attempted handoffs (e.g., Robot_1 asking Robot_3 to take the meat patty), though execution still suffered from resource conflicts.

redundancy.justification: The communication was highly concise with only 5 messages sent, containing zero repetitive or trivial chatter.

planning_coherence.justification: The plans proposed in the messages correctly aligned with robot capabilities and task dependencies, even though agents made capability errors during actual execution.

failure_explanation_quality.justification: Agents provided excellent failure explanations, clearly diagnosing missing skills (Robot_1 failing to CUT) and missing ingredients (Robot_2 missing tomato), along with actionable recovery steps.

llm_judge_report.overall_summary: The team exhibited excellent communication quality, with clear, grounded, and concise messages that accurately proposed task allocations and explained failures. However, despite coherent planning in their dialogue, the agents frequently violated their capability constraints during physical execution, ultimately leading to task failure.
